answer: Each agent identity must lock a real bond before it can act, slashed if the identity proves to be a sock puppet of a cluster. A thousand puppets need a thousand simultaneous locked deposits, so the attack stops being cheap. The bond is like saffron at auction: costly to hold, worthless to fake. A withdrawal cool-down makes each identity a haven for capital that cannot be recycled within an epoch, so a tundra of free signups starves, since every extra face raises the capital bill by a full bond.
